tabs.content:
// SILVER LAYER
.execute database script <|

// Contains all orders for Rapid Delivery only.
.create table SilverRapidOrders (
    SalesOrderNumber: long,
    OrderDate: datetime,
    OrderTime: string,
    CustomerKey: string,
    CustomerName: string,
    CustomerAddress: string,
    CustomerPostalCode: string,
    ProductKey: long,
    OrderQuantity: long,
    UnitPrice: real,
    DiscountAmount: real,
    ProductStandardCost: real,
    TotalProductCost: real,
    TotalSalesAmount: real,
    TaxAmt: real,
    Freight: real,
    ExtendedAmount: real,
    ProductCategory: string,
    ProductName: string,
    ResellerName: string,
    ResellerAddressLine1: string,
    ResellerAddressLine2: string,
    ResellerPostalCode: long,
    ResellerLatitude: real,
    ResellerLongitude: real,
    ResellerEntraID: string,
    CustomerDistanceToReseller: real,
    IsRapidDelivery: long
) with (folder = "Silver")

// Create SilverRapidDeliveryNearestDrivers table
.create table SilverRapidDeliveryNearestDrivers (
    SalesOrderNumber: long,
    OrderDate: datetime,
    OrderTime: string,
    CustomerName: string,
    DeliveryAddress: string,
    DeliveryPostalCode: string,
    ProductName: string,
    OrderQuantity: long,
    ResellerName: string,
    PickupAddressLine1: string,
    PickupAddressLine2: string,
    PickupPostalCode: long,
    CustomerDistanceToReseller: real,
    TruckDistanceToReseller: real,
    TruckEntraID: string,
    TruckID: real
) with (folder = "Silver")
tabs.title: Create Silver Tables

tabs.content:
.append SilverRapidOrders <|
RapidDelivery
| join kind = inner 
(FabrikamProducts) on ($left.ProductKey == $right.StockItemID)
| join kind = inner 
(FabrikamCustomers) on ($left.CustomerKey == $right.CustomerID)
| extend key = 1
| join kind = inner 
(FabrikamResellers | extend key = 1) on key
// Update Data Types on existing columns
| extend DiscountAmount = toreal(DiscountAmount)
| extend ProductStandardCost = toreal(ProductStandardCost) 
| extend UnitPrice = toreal(UnitPrice)
| extend OrderDate = todatetime(OrderDate)
| extend ShipDate = todatetime(ShipDate)
| extend DueDate = todatetime(DueDate)
| extend TotalProductCost = toreal(ProductStandardCost * OrderQuantity)
| extend TotalSalesAmount = toreal(UnitPrice * OrderQuantity)
| extend TaxAmt = TotalSalesAmount * 0.08875
| extend Freight = 10.00
| extend ExtendedAmount = TotalSalesAmount + Freight + TaxAmt 
| extend CustomerDistanceToReseller = geo_distance_2points(Latitude, Longitude, Latitude1, Longitude1)
| summarize arg_min(CustomerDistanceToReseller, *) by SalesOrderNumber
| extend IsRapidDelivery = tolong(IsRapidDelivery)  // <-- fix type mismatch
| project SalesOrderNumber, OrderDate, OrderTime, CustomerKey, 
CustomerName = FullName, 
CustomerAddress = Address, 
CustomerPostalCode = ZipCode,
ProductKey, OrderQuantity, UnitPrice, DiscountAmount, ProductStandardCost, 
TotalProductCost, TotalSalesAmount, TaxAmt, Freight, ExtendedAmount, 
ProductCategory = StockGroupName, ProductName = StockItemName, 
ResellerName, 
ResellerAddressLine1 = DeliveryAddressLine1, 
ResellerAddressLine2 = DeliveryAddressLine2, 
ResellerPostalCode = DeliveryPostalCode, 
ResellerLatitude = Latitude, 
ResellerLongitude = Longitude, 
ResellerEntraID, 
CustomerDistanceToReseller, 
IsRapidDelivery
tabs.title: Append Table

tabs.content:
// Use update policies to transform data during Ingestion
.execute database script <|
// Update Policy for SilverRapidOrders
.create-or-alter function with (docstring = 'Add additional columns and data enrichment') fn_SilverRapidOrders (){
RapidDelivery
| join kind = inner (FabrikamProducts) on ($left.ProductKey == $right.StockItemID)
| join kind = inner (FabrikamCustomers) on ($left.CustomerKey == $right.CustomerID)
| extend key = 1
| join kind = inner (FabrikamResellers | extend key = 1) on key
| extend DiscountAmount = toreal(DiscountAmount)
| extend ProductStandardCost = toreal(ProductStandardCost) 
| extend UnitPrice = toreal(UnitPrice)
| extend OrderDate = todatetime(OrderDate)
| extend ShipDate = todatetime(ShipDate)
| extend DueDate = todatetime(DueDate)
| extend TotalProductCost = toreal(ProductStandardCost * OrderQuantity)
| extend TotalSalesAmount = toreal(UnitPrice * OrderQuantity)
| extend TaxAmt = TotalSalesAmount * 0.08875
| extend Freight = 10.00
| extend ExtendedAmount = TotalSalesAmount + Freight + TaxAmt 
| extend CustomerDistanceToReseller = 
geo_distance_2points(Latitude, Longitude, Latitude1, Longitude1)
| summarize arg_min(CustomerDistanceToReseller, *) by SalesOrderNumber
| project SalesOrderNumber, OrderDate, OrderTime, CustomerKey, 
CustomerName = FullName, CustomerAddress = Address,
CustomerPostalCode = ZipCode, ProductKey, OrderQuantity, 
UnitPrice, DiscountAmount, ProductStandardCost, 
TotalProductCost, TotalSalesAmount, TaxAmt, Freight,
ExtendedAmount, ProductCategory = StockGroupName, 
ProductName = StockItemName, ResellerName, 
ResellerAddressLine1 = DeliveryAddressLine1,
ResellerAddressLine2 = DeliveryAddressLine2, 
ResellerPostalCode = DeliveryPostalCode, ResellerLatitude = Latitude,
ResellerLongitude = Longitude, ResellerEntraID, 
CustomerDistanceToReseller, IsRapidDelivery = tolong(IsRapidDelivery)
}
// Create an update policy on the SilverOrdersDrivers table
.alter table RapidDelivery policy streamingingestion disable
.alter table SilverRapidOrders policy update @'[{"Source": "RapidDelivery", "Query": "fn_SilverRapidOrders", "IsEnabled" : true, "IsTransactional": true }]'
// Create a function to capture the 3 nearest drivers
.create function  ifnotexists with (docstring = 'Add additional columns and data enrichment. Find three nearest drivers.') fn_SilverRapidDeliveryNearestDrivers ()
{
SilverRapidOrders
| extend key = 1
| join kind = inner 
(TruckMovement |  extend key = 1) on key
| summarize arg_max(EventProcessedUtcTime, *) by TruckIDClean = toreal(TruckID), SalesOrderNumber
| join kind = inner 
(FabrikamDeliveryTrucks) on $left.TruckIDClean == $right.TruckID
| extend TruckDistanceToReseller = geo_distance_2points(latitude, longitude, ResellerLatitude, ResellerLongitude)
| extend OrderDate = todatetime(OrderDate)
| extend IsRapidDelivery = tolong(IsRapidDelivery)
| project 
    SalesOrderNumber,  OrderDate, OrderTime, CustomerName, 
    DeliveryAddress = CustomerAddress,
    DeliveryPostalCode = CustomerPostalCode, ProductName, 
    OrderQuantity, ResellerName, 
    PickupAddressLine1 = ResellerAddressLine1, 
    PickupAddressLine2 = ResellerAddressLine2, 
    PickupPostalCode = ResellerPostalCode, 
    CustomerDistanceToReseller, TruckDistanceToReseller, 
    TruckEntraID, TruckID = TruckIDClean
| partition hint.strategy = shuffle by SalesOrderNumber (top 3 by TruckDistanceToReseller asc)
}
// Create an update policy on the SilverOrdersDrivers table
.alter table SilverRapidOrders policy streamingingestion disable
.alter table SilverRapidDeliveryNearestDrivers policy update @'[{"Source": "SilverRapidOrders", "Query": "fn_SilverRapidDeliveryNearestDrivers", "IsEnabled" : true, "IsTransactional": true }]'
tabs.title: Update Policies

tabs.content:
.show table SilverRapidOrders policy update

SilverRapidOrders
| project SalesOrderNumber, ingestion_time(), ProductKey, CustomerKey
| top 10 by ingestion_time() desc
